description: This file defines the 'Sale' class within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It handles displaying sales data, configuring settings, and saving user preferences for the sale dashboard widget.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Represents the sale dashboard widget in the OpenCart admin panel, managing display, configuration, and data retrieval for sales metrics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the sale dashboard widget, sets up breadcrumbs, configuration options, and loads necessary views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the sale widget settings, including permission checking and updating configuration.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for today and yesterday, calculates sales differences and total sales, and renders the sale info view.
